faqs.question: What does JEV RNA Detection by Real-time PCR - EDTA Blood measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) RNA in your blood.

faqs.question: Why is JEV RNA Detection by Real-time PCR - EDTA Blood done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) infection • To assess the severity of the infection • To monitor the effectiveness of treatment • To identify outbreaks of JEV infections in a region

faqs.question: When is the JEV RNA Detection test recommended, and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: The JEV RNA Detection test is recommended if you have • symptoms of headache, fever, neck stiffness, seizures, or confusion, • a history of travelling to regions where JEV is endemic, • a diagnosis of acute encephalitis syndrome (AES), or • an immunocompromised status.

faqs.question: What if the results of the JEV RNA Detection test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: A positive result for the JEV RNA Detection test suggests that you have been infected by the virus. A negative result does not necessarily rule out JEV infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the JEV RNA Detection blood test?
faqs.answer: A technician will draw a blood sample from a vein in your arm. They will send the blood sample to the laboratory for testing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the JEV RNA Detection test?
faqs.answer: • You do not need to fast or make any dietary changes. • Inform your doctor if you are taking any medications or supplements. Also, let them know if you have any specific requirements. • Tell the technician if you have any bleeding disorders or are on blood-thinning medication.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the JEV RNA Detection test?
faqs.answer: • Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) Tests: RT-PCR tests may be done on cerebrospinal fluid or tissue samples to diagnose encephalitis. • Complete Blood Count (CBC): A CBC measures the number of blood cells in your bloodstream and can indicate if you have an infection.

faqs.question: What is JEV RNA Detection by Real-time PCR - EDTA Blood test also known as?
faqs.answer: Real-time PCR for detection of Japanese encephalitis virus RNA in EDTA blood

faqs.question: What is Japanese Encephalitis?
faqs.answer: Japanese encephalitis (JE) is a viral infection that spreads through mosquito bites. Symptoms include headache, fever, neck stiffness, seizures, or confusion. JE can cause inflammation of the brain and spinal cord, leading to brain damage or death.
